type.quote: The Board for Contractors shall be composed of 16 members as follows: one member shall be a licensed Class A general contractor; ... one member shall be a licensed plumbing contractor; one member shall be a licensed electrical contractor; one member shall be a licensed heating, ventilation and air conditioning contractor

exams.name: Tradesman examination
exams.notes: Oral or written examination on general knowledge of the trade; exempt if certified/licensed by Board of Housing and Community Development prior to July 1, 1995, or by local governing body prior to July 1, 1978, or through an approved apprenticeship program.
exams.quote: the applicant shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of the trade in which he desires licensure

interval_years.quote: A license for a tradesman shall be valid for three years from the date of issuance.

required.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

available.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth

requirements.value: Universal license recognition: must hold current valid license in another state for at least 3 years, in a profession with similar scope; must have passed an exam and met standards in that state; no pending investigations; good standing; no disqualifying criminal record; no discipline (except financial-only penalties); pay applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The individual holds a current and valid professional or occupational license or government certification in another state in a profession or occupation with a similar scope of practice, as determined by the board in the Commonwealth; The individual has held the professional or occupational license or government certification in the other state for at least three years

exists.quote: The Board for Contractors shall be composed of 16 members as follows: ... one member shall be a licensed plumbing contractor

is_mandatory.quote: Beginning July 1, 1995, no individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

title_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen in the Commonwealth.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education and to suspend, revoke or deny renewal of the certification or license of any individual who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in work as a tradesman without a required license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who finds that an individual is practicing as a tradesman, elevator mechanic, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider without a license as required by this article shall file a report to such effect with the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing incompetently as demonstrated by an egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who has reason to believe that a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider is performing incompetently as demonstrated by an egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of statutes or regulations governing licensed contractors, including fraud, misrepresentation, and dishonest conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education, suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of the license or certificate of any contractor who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed or certified contractors in the Commonwealth.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a statute or regulation involving fraudulent, improper, or dishonest conduct that occurred during a declared state of emergency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the Board finds any person licensed under the provisions of this chapter to be in violation of a statute or regulation involving fraudulent or improper or dishonest conduct as defined in § 54.1-1118, which violation occurred while engaged in a transaction initiated arising from a declared state of emergency

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.

grounds for denial or revocation of tradesman license

definition_quote.value: "Tradesman" means any individual who engages in, or offers to engage in, work for the general public for compensation in the trades of electrical, plumbing and heating, ventilation and air conditioning.
definition_quote.quote: "Tradesman" means any individual who engages in, or offers to engage in, work for the general public for compensation in the trades of electrical, plumbing and heating, ventilation and air conditioning.

license_tiers.quote: The Board may grant a Class A license in any of the following classifications: (i) residential building contractor, (ii) commercial building contractor, (iii) highway/heavy contractor, (iv) electrical contractor, (v) plumbing contractor, (vi) heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractor, (vii) fire sprinkler contractor, and (viii) specialty contractor.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: Individuals working under the supervision of a tradesman licensed in the plumbing specialty are not subject to licensure as a tradesman.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Individuals shall not be subject to licensure as a tradesman when working under the supervision of a tradesman who is licensed in the specialty for which work is being performed.

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.quote: "Natural gas fitter provider" means any individual who engages in or offers to engage in work for the general public for compensation in the incidental repair, testing, or removal of natural gas piping or fitting annexed to real property, excluding new installation of gas piping for hot water heaters, boilers, central heating systems, or other natural gas equipment which requires heating, ventilation and air conditioning or plumbing certification.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: The Board shall require a master tradesmen license as a condition of licensure for electrical, plumbing, and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractors.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: the contractor shall within 90 days of that departure provide to the Board the name of the new designated employee.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: The provisions of this article shall not apply to any individual who is performing work on ... a single-family residence where the value of the work performed is less than $250 and such individual does not hold himself out to the general public as a tradesman.

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: Work undertaken by a person providing construction, remodeling, repair, improvement, removal, or demolition valued at $25,000 or less per project on behalf of a properly licensed contractor
